response.sql: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count FROM Accounts AS a JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.town_city) <> '' GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city), scored AS (SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, transaction_count * 1e0 / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city), 0) AS town_share, transaction_count * 1e0 / NULLIF(AVG(transaction_count * 1e0) OVER (), 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM account_counts) SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, town_share, ratio_to_average FROM scored ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, account_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A missing town includes NULL, empty, and whitespace-only values.
A share or ratio with a zero denominator is NULL; account id breaks ties in the top 10.
